notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card during an opponent's turn.
description:
Draw a card during an opponent's turn.
The Watcher's first ability riggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters the battlefield, Symmetry Matrix and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Tentacle on the battlefield.
Resolve the Symmetry Matrix trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
